about: Made-up pairs of questions for the embeddings that drop a new question asking what an earlier one asks (generation's distinct_by_meaning, DUPLICATE_DISTANCE): the same ask reworded or reordered, and traps that share most words but ask something else (first vs last, opens vs closes), in English and six other languages, one per script family. Graded by code. Hand-written.

items.a: What does a VLOOKUP-style lookup return when no row matches the key?
items.b: Which result does a lookup over a table give when none of its rows has the key?

items.a: Which entry records a customer paying in cash for goods?
items.b: A customer pays cash for goods: which entry is recorded?

items.a: How long can cooked rice stay at room temperature before it must be chilled?
items.b: What is the longest cooked rice may sit out before refrigeration?

items.a: Which document proves a car's ownership?
items.b: Which document proves a car is insured?
items.kind: trap: one word apart, another ask
